reviewer: Codex visual inspection and gameplay evidence review
findings: Beveled block colors, ghost outline, level/line count and next-piece queue remain readable in the single well.
Two distinct wells, separate score/line counts and next columns fit inside the native frame.
Real control policies clear the default line target in native 1P/2P browser runs; equal simultaneous policies produce equal boards and a shared win.
Behavior evidence separately exercises seven-bag fairness, wall kicks, bounded lock resets, soft drop, real stacking topout, independent P2 input and P2 victory when P1 tops out.
limits: Fixed original kicks are not exact SRS/Guideline compatibility; no hold, counterclockwise rotation or T-spin scoring is implemented.
The 2P next-piece previews are compact and need physical CRT review before claiming cabinet-distance readability.
The placement policy runs faster than a human; its roughly ten-second clear proves reachability, not calibrated pacing.
No human balance study, physical CRT overscan/calibration or badge/controller hardware validation.
